A heartbeat bond works like a rental deposit. Each identity locks 150 units and sends a heartbeat signal per epoch proving real work. The deposit stays untouched while it beats on time.

A missed heartbeat leaves a raven mark and forfeits 10%. Three misses in a row forfeit it all. The delta between live and dead is heartbeats.

Ten honest epochs refund a 5% bonus. 1,000 clones lock 150,000 units; 30% missing heartbeats forfeit 45,000 per cycle.
